scripts.sync: cp ../remote/index.html web/index.html && npx cap sync android
scripts.apk: npm run sync && cd android && JAVA_HOME="${JAVA_HOME:-/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home}" ./gradlew assembleDebug && cp app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ../MollyRemote.apk && echo Built debug ../MollyRemote.apk
scripts.release: npm run sync && cd android && JAVA_HOME="${JAVA_HOME:-/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home}" ./gradlew assembleRelease && cp app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk ../MollyRemote.apk && echo Built signed release ../MollyRemote.apk
